name: Halloween
description: A haunted night: a big moon with clouds crossing it, a haunted house on a hill with flickering windows, a graveyard and dead trees, will-o'-the-wisps, lightning now and then, bats, crows, a witch, ghosts and a skeleton hand. Lantern patches light the page and the headings drip in Creepster. An unknown new device is a werewolf under a blood moon, held at the graveyard gate.
author: BAMF
